What hiring signals

  • Autonomy / AI stack: world models, foundation models, AI core software, dataloop/release — learning systems alongside classical flight controls.
  • Integration & verification: staff/senior systems, avionics, flight controls, and flight dynamics roles consistent with prepare-for-integrate / ground-test work after C-130J CDR.
  • Public-company finance & legal: assistant controller, strategic finance, assistant GC.
  • DC / maritime GTM: GM Maritime and Director, Market Strategy in Washington DC.
  • Certification build-out (two roles posted 5 Oct 2026): a Senior Airworthiness & Certification Engineer to lead compliance work with military and civil regulators, and a Senior Aviation Cyber Certification Engineer whose posting says Merlin is “establishing the civil side of our aviation cyber certification capability” under DO-326A. Both are Boston or Remote, $165k–$220k base. (airworthiness posting · cyber posting)
  • Human-machine teaming (posted 7 Oct 2026): a Senior Human-Machine Teaming Engineer in Boston to build human-machine and machine-machine teaming software for autonomous aircraft, covering multi-vehicle autonomy, human subject testing, and proposal writing. Pay band on the posting: $165k–$220k base. (Lever posting)
  • Smithfield, RI: the 18 Sep on-site Aircraft Modification Manager posting ($150k–$200k base) was no longer on the board on 7 Oct. Every current posting lists Smithfield, Rhode Island as a Merlin flight test facility with Kerikeri and soon Bedford. (Lever board)
